name: Perception-Playground (ROS 2 Jazzy + Nav2)
postStartCommand: tigervncserver -kill :1 > /dev/null 2>&1; rm -f /root/.vnc/*:1.pid; setsid nohup bash -c 'start-vnc.sh' > /tmp/start-vnc.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & for i in $(seq 1 25); do [ -S /tmp/.X11-unix/X1 ] && break; sleep 1; done; DISPLAY=:1 glxinfo -B > /tmp/gpu-renderer.log 2>&1; grep -E 'Device|Accelerated|OpenGL renderer' /tmp/gpu-renderer.log > /tmp/gpu-check.log 2>&1 || true
